definitions.explanation: The continent of North America, including Canada, the United States, and Mexico. In Japanese geographical classification, sometimes also includes Central America and the Caribbean.

examples.japanese: {北|きた}アメリカ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧。

examples.english: There are many countries on the North American continent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{北|きた}アメリカ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一周|いっしゅう}→一周：08917_isshuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: He set out on a trip around North America.

notes:
Written either as {北|きた}アメリカ or ⟦{北米|ほくべい}→北米：17097_hokubei⟧. The full form {北|きた}アメリカ is more common in everyday speech and writing, while ⟦{北米|ほくべい}→北米：17097_hokubei⟧ is a Sino-Japanese abbreviation used in news, formal writing, and compound terms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {北|きた}アメリカ{大陸|たいりく}: the North American continent
- {北|きた}アメリカ⟦{諸国|しょこく}→諸国：15992_shokoku⟧: North American countries
- {北|きた}アメリカ⟦{原産|げんさん}→原産：04180_gensan⟧: native to North America

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{北米|ほくべい}→北米：17097_hokubei⟧: North America — Sino-Japanese abbreviation; more formal and compact
- ⟦{南|みなみ}アメリカ→南アメリカ：26753_minamiamerika⟧: South America — the southern counterpart
- ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧: Central America — the region between North and South America
